title: Clear of the Branch
subject: animals
author: Clueberry Desk
introduction: Ten birds and the words that follow them about.

entries.clue: Leave for the season, and mean to come back
A bird's whole coat, feather by feather
Cliff nester with a striped summer bill
Tropical bird whose oversized bill sheds heat
Long-legged stander at the water's edge
Tidy the feathers, or admire oneself
Black corvid kept at the Tower of London

factCards.text: A toucan's bill is a heat exchanger: blood flow through it can be adjusted to release or conserve body heat.
factCards.sourceTitle: Science 325, 468 (2009) — Tattersall, Andrade & Abe, 'Heat Exchange from the Toucan Bill'

factCards.text: Atlantic puffins carry a brightly coloured outer bill plate only in the breeding season, shedding it after nesting.
The Arctic tern's annual migration is the longest known of any bird, though published estimates of the distance differ substantially between tracking studies.
factCards.sourceTitle: PNAS 107, 2078 (2010) — Egevang et al., tracking of Arctic terns
